role: historical August sparse-model known-key control receipt playback

answers.question: What did the August sparse-model pipeline do on a message whose answer was already known?
answers.answer: On a published control cut to 72 letters, the IC-only true-key rank was 223,118 of 456,976, phase two recovered 4/72 letters and 0/10 plugs, and the historical tool printed NO BREAK. Current phase two supersedes those recovery values with 25/72 and 5/10, still NO BREAK.

reproduce.behavior: Renders deterministic playback of a preserved historical receipt. It runs no benchmark, test suite, synthesis, or cracking run.
reproduce.workspacePathConstraint: The tape records to an absolute path under /Volumes/Code/MuleinLabs and must be adjusted if the workspace is relocated.

capturedAtBasis: Rendered during the documentation pass; the underlying August experiment is dated in its preserved receipt

captureMethod.mode: normal-speed playback of a preserved historical receipt

artifacts.kind: durable byte-for-byte copy used by the tape

experiment.truth: UKW B, gamma, IV-III-VIII, rings AACU, message key VYAA, 10 plugs
experiment.lettersRationale: same length as the P1030680 target

levelOne.currentStatus: unchanged by dense table and objective repairs

levelThree.currentStatus: The likeness label is retired; current publication assessment remains NO BREAK.

experiment.interpretation: Preserved as the sparse-model before state. Its phase-two recovery is superseded; it must not be described as the current ceiling.

timingContext.interpretation: The capture replays preserved text at normal speed. Any elapsed-time figures visible on screen are historical observations from the original run on one Apple-silicon host, not fresh measurements and not portable performance contracts.

claimBoundaries: This is playback of a preserved historical receipt. No cracking run was performed for the capture.
The 4/72 and 0/10 phase-two values belong to the August sparse model and are not current.
The current repaired-objective values are 25/72 and 5/10, still NO BREAK.
The historical likeness value is not a probability or current confidence measure.
The unchanged 223,118/456,976 IC rank remains a valid internal control.
No claim is made that P1030680 has a key, plaintext, or break.
